note: Private RV park on 25 wooded acres at the southeast edge of Jamestown, a mile down a gravel frontage road west of I-94 exit 256 (some GPS units misroute; the operator's directions follow the south frontage road). Mature trees shade most sites; interstate noise reaches the park. Dog park, walking path and canopy walk. --Claude
summary: Operator site live: 41 RV pull-throughs (55-86 ft; full hookup 30/50, W/E, electric-only) + 6 tent sites, 2026 rates $30-45 (2027 not posted), Good Sam Park 10%, books online via campgroundreservations.com. Google 4.5/465. Transient interstate park; passes price, presence and long-stay tests. Groups now manual; note rewritten.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: price $30-45 (under $50 before any discount; Good Sam 10% stated by the operator). Presence: live operator site with phone and online booking; Google 4.5 with 465 reviews; RV Life 4.5 $$. Long-stay: transient I-94 stop-over (every RV site bookable online by the night; reviews are 1-3 night travellers); weekly and monthly rates offered on request only, no seasonal wording. No gateway within 40 km (not needed).
SEASON: regular season May 1-Sep 30 with weather-dependent April and October; the posted rates run Apr 1-Oct 31.
